intro_section.title: Private Transfer Between Liberia Airport and La Fortuna & Arenal
paragraphs: Wild Papagayo arranges private transportation between Liberia Airport (LIR) and La Fortuna & Arenal, in both directions. The vehicle and driver are for your group only, not a shared shuttle, and the drive takes roughly 2.5 to 3 hours.

Liberia Airport is officially Daniel Oduber Quirós International Airport and is also known as Guanacaste Airport. Pricing for this route is by quote: send your dates, direction, group size and flight details on WhatsApp and we will reply with a quote.

This Liberia Airport to La Fortuna transfer is not offered for flights arriving at night. Whether we can take your transfer depends on your flight's arrival time and our operating availability, so include your flight details when you ask.

how_it_works.title: How Your Transfer Works, Step by Step
steps: Send your request on WhatsApp: the direction (airport to La Fortuna & Arenal, or back to the airport), your date, flight details, group size and where you are staying in La Fortuna & Arenal.
We check whether the transfer is available for your flight time and reply with a quote.
If you go ahead, we confirm your booking in writing and arrange a private vehicle and driver for your group.
On arrival at LIR, your driver meets you in the arrivals area with a sign bearing your name. Exact meeting details are confirmed with your booking.
For the return trip, tell us your departure flight time and we plan your pickup for the drive back to Liberia Airport.

faq.q: Is this a private transfer or a shared shuttle?
faq.a: It is a private transfer. The vehicle and driver are for your group only and are not shared with other travelers.

faq.q: How long is the drive from Liberia Airport to La Fortuna & Arenal?
faq.a: Roughly 2.5 to 3 hours. This is a planning estimate, and timing varies with weather and road conditions.

faq.q: How much does a private transfer from Liberia Airport to La Fortuna & Arenal cost?
faq.a: We price this route by quote, and no fixed price is published. Send your dates, direction, group size and flight details on WhatsApp and we will reply with a quote.

faq.q: Can I book the return trip from La Fortuna & Arenal to Liberia Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Return transportation is covered on this same route. Tell us your departure flight time and where you are staying when you request your quote.

faq.q: Is the transfer available for flights that arrive at night?
faq.a: No. This Liberia Airport to La Fortuna & Arenal transfer is not offered for flights arriving at night. Availability depends on your flight's arrival time and our operating availability, so send your flight details before you book if your flight lands late in the day.

faq.q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faq.a: Let us know as soon as you can. We accommodate the first 60 minutes of waiting at no charge, and for longer delays we work with you to adjust the plan rather than cancel.

faq.q: Where will my driver meet me at the airport?
faq.a: In the arrivals area at LIR, with a sign bearing your name. Exact meeting details are confirmed with your booking.

faq.q: Can I request a child seat?
faq.a: You can ask for one when you request your quote, and we will confirm availability.

faq.q: What should I tell you about my luggage?
faq.a: Mention your luggage when you request your quote, especially anything unusual or oversized, so we can plan the vehicle accordingly.

faq.q: How far in advance do I need to book?
faq.a: There is no fixed lead time; it depends on availability for your dates. Send your request as soon as your plans are set.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for private transfers?
faq.a: A 25% deposit confirms your transfer and the remaining balance is due no later than 72 hours before pickup; bookings made within 72 hours are paid in full. Cancellations made more than 72 hours before pickup receive the refundable amount paid, less any applicable non-recoverable payment-processing costs when legally permitted. Cancellations within 72 hours of pickup are non-refundable, subject to any mandatory consumer rights. Cancellations must be submitted in writing by WhatsApp or email; see our Booking & Cancellation Policy for details.
